ratings_why.fun: From Tier 4 each turn is a small counting puzzle with a payout, and the Flashpoint caps every per-turn payoff, so growth climbs steeply without running away; the first three tiers are thin.
ratings_why.distinct: A push-your-luck dial with two opposite builds (stop at 7 or blow past it) plays unlike any of today's tribes or a plain spell tribe, though spells-as-fuel itself is familiar.

verdict_why: Nothing is broken or unreadable; what's left is numbers for the owner and early-game flavour, which would make it different rather than better.

points.text: Turns 1-4 run on the shop spell and one Uncertain Phial, so Treacle Painter and the Burnet's Bristle rarely see much Heat. A cheap Stoke source at Tier 1 or 2 would let the dial matter from turn 2.

Burnt-Ring Senior has no limit on in-fight Flares. With The Alchymist at Flashpoint 3, Eyed Hawk-moth hits and Moth deaths Flare again and again mid-fight, each one a permanent buff to every Moth. If it runs hot, 'Twice a fight' is the dial to turn.

The Alchymist plus The Spectacle may become every build's late default, since it makes both 'exactly the Flashpoint' and Flaring easy. Its catch, a 3-Heat cap that shrinks Mother Shipton and the Hawk-moth, is a good one. Keep it visible.
Dame Pavonia's 6/8 body never grows, so she falls behind late. That's a fair price for a multiplier, but she's only worth it with two End of Turn Moths already on board.

standouts.why: Lamplit Compounder makes cast order matter, and the Flashpoint caps it, so the seed's 'spells grow stronger' compounds without running away.
The Spectacle is a solid board-wide buffer whose top rate rewards hitting exactly 7: the tribe's main idea on one card.
The Alchymist changes the rule every card reads, which is what a Tier 6 capstone should do.

weakest.why: Skep Pilferer is a generic gold-per-spell piece with no Heat decision in it.
Lamp-Fanner is a 3/3 that does nothing by itself until Tier 4 payoffs arrive.
Show-Globe Keeper is plain Phial supply. It's needed, but there's no choice in it beyond selling.

flags.note: In-fight Flares are unlimited. At Flashpoint 3 a long fight can give several permanent board-wide buffs, more with a golden copy.
Pavonia doubling Old Carbonaria in a Flare turn with Burnished Brass and Lamp-Fanner can top 200 stats, above the Tier 6 top end.
At Heat 7, Mother Shipton deals 14 to three enemies at Start of Combat, 28 if golden, which can wipe a front row on the turn she lands.
